Package game.plants

Interface PlantAbility

All Known Implementing Classes:
Grow, PeriodicAbility, Produce, SelfReplicate
public interface PlantAbility
One thing a Plant may do on its turn, such as growing into its next stage, self-replicating, or producing an item.

A plant tries its abilities in priority order and stops at the first one that actually does something, so every ability must report whether it acted. An empty string means it did nothing this turn.

    • forcePerform

      default String forcePerform(Plant plant, Location location)
      Tries this ability immediately, skipping whatever gating a subclass normally applies before tryPerform(game.plants.Plant, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location) (such as an interval or a chance roll). An ability with no such gating behaves exactly like tryPerform(game.plants.Plant, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Location); PeriodicAbility overrides this to go straight to its effect instead.
      Parameters:
      plant - the plant using this ability
      location - the location of the plant
      Returns:
      a description of what happened, including coordinates, or an empty string if nothing happened
